PHASE 1: AWS SETUP
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

□ Step 1: Login to AWS Console
  → https://aws.amazon.com/console/
  
□ Step 2: Open IAM Dashboard
  → Search bar → type "IAM" → click IAM
  
□ Step 3: Click "Users" in left sidebar
  
□ Step 4: Click orange "Create user" button
  
□ Step 5: Enter user name: github-actions-deployer
  → DO NOT check console access
  → Click "Next"
  
□ Step 6: Attach Policies
  → Select "Attach policies directly"
  → Search and CHECK: AWSElasticBeanstalkFullAccess
  → Search and CHECK: AmazonS3FullAccess
  → Click "Next"
  
□ Step 7: Click "Create user"
  
□ Step 8: Click on username → "Security credentials" tab
  
□ Step 9: Scroll to "Access keys" → "Create access key"
  
□ Step 10: Select "Third-party service" → Check box → "Next"
  
□ Step 11: Click "Create access key"
  
□ Step 12: ⚠️ SAVE THESE (only shown once!) ⚠️
  
  Open text editor and paste:
  ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIA________________           │
  │ AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=___________________________│
  │ AWS_ACCOUNT_ID=____________                       │
  └───────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  
□ Step 13: Copy Access Key ID to text file
  
□ Step 14: Copy Secret Access Key to text file
  
□ Step 15: Click "Done"
  
□ Step 16: Get Account ID
  → Top-right → Click your name → See Account ID (12 digits)
  → Add to text file


PHASE 2: GITHUB SETUP
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

□ Step 1: Open repository in browser
  → https://github.com/sunilverma231/End-to-end-Machine-Learning-Project-
  
□ Step 2: Click "Settings" tab (top menu)
  
□ Step 3: Left sidebar → "Secrets and variables" → "Actions"
  
□ Step 4: Click "New repository secret"
  
□ Step 5: Add First Secret
  Name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
  Secret: [paste from text file]
  → Click "Add secret"
  
□ Step 6: Click "New repository secret" again
  
□ Step 7: Add Second Secret
  Name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Secret: [paste from text file]
  → Click "Add secret"
  
□ Step 8: Click "New repository secret" again
  
□ Step 9: Add Third Secret
  Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
  Secret: [paste 12-digit number]
  → Click "Add secret"
  
□ Step 10: Verify you see 3 secrets in the list


PHASE 3: TEST DEPLOYMENT
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

□ Step 1: Open terminal
  
□ Step 2: Navigate to project
  cd /Users/sunilverma/Desktop/End-to-end-Machine-Learning-Project-
  
□ Step 3: Add all files
  git add .
  
□ Step 4: Commit
  git commit -m "feat: Add CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions"
  
□ Step 5: Push to trigger deployment
  git push origin main
  
□ Step 6: Watch deployment
  → Open: https://github.com/sunilverma231/End-to-end-Machine-Learning-Project-/actions
  → See yellow dot 🟡 → wait for green ✅
  
□ Step 7: Wait ~7 minutes for completion
  
□ Step 8: Verify success
  → GitHub Actions shows green ✅
  → App URL still works
  → AWS EB shows new version


VERIFICATION CHECKLIST
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

□ IAM user exists in AWS
□ IAM user has 2 policies attached
□ Access keys are saved in text file
□ GitHub has 3 secrets (all green, no warnings)
□ Git push triggered GitHub Actions
□ All workflow steps show green ✅
□ App URL loads: http://studentperformanceenv1-env.eba-wbvx3wpb.eu-north-1.elasticbeanstalk.com/
□ Can make prediction successfully


COMMON MISTAKES TO AVOID
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

❌ Forgetting to save access keys (can't retrieve later!)
❌ Extra spaces in GitHub secrets
❌ Wrong AWS_ACCOUNT_ID (must be exactly 12 digits)
❌ Not checking "Third-party service" when creating keys
❌ Not attaching policies to IAM user
❌ Using personal AWS account ID instead of the one from console
